pages.name: add-p1
pages.after: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-pressed]')][0];if(b){if(b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='false')b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));return b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200))}return 'no button'})()

pages.name: compare-products
pages.after: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<40&&!document.querySelector('table');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200));const t=document.querySelector('table');const wrap=t&&t.parentElement;return {caption:t&&t.querySelector('caption').textContent,cols:t?t.querySelectorAll('thead th').length:0,rows:t?t.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length:0,wrapScrolls:wrap?wrap.scrollWidth>wrap.clientWidth:null}})()
